$comment: Claims a later ADR retired. scripts/check-retired-claims.mjs fails when live code, skills or guides repeat one. ADRs, testing evidence, proposals and release notes keep history and are not scanned.

claims.pattern: \b(an?|persistent|AI) agent lead\b|personal AI assistant with a personality
claims.now: Clankie is a self-hosted platform for leads; the persona is its built-in lead.

claims.pattern: mark(ing|ed)? (it|the pull request|a pull request) ready (also )?(runs|starts|adds) the real-app run|ready pull requests? adds? the real-app run
claims.now: No pull request runs the real app; it runs on main after merges and nightly, and a red run files a ci-finding issue.

claims.pattern: account supports .*official Discord bot|\bexisting hosted bod(y|ies)\b
claims.now: Clankie runs only on the owner's machines and joins Discord through the owner's own bot.
Fleet membership gets connected tools; projects keep roles, caps, hiring and tracker binding.
Clankie hires through hire_agent and reaches agents through native channels and message_clankie.
His agents form a fleet, reached through native channels.
Workers publish to Linear through the workspace Clankie app.
Every hired worker runs its harness's native TUI in a Herdr pane.
Signed Linear activity appears in its project lead chat or fallback; normal conversation history and linear_wake consumption receipts replace the separate inbox protocol.
One wake target setting selects an ordinary global chat; the lead chooses any work delegation.
Every change lands through a pull request that merges on local checks plus the quick PR checks, rebased once right before merging.

claims.pattern: changes through the landing queue|do not push main directly
claims.now: Every change lands through a pull request that merges on local checks plus the quick PR checks, rebased once right before merging.

claims.pattern: shuts the device down and deletes it only if the lease created it
claims.now: Release and expiry stop and retain leased simulator devices for reuse; deletion requires an explicit owner tidy.
Rivals is an external game extension in the rivals-agent repository; install it with clankie games extensions add MODULE url=ORIGIN.
Projects on Auto carry standing work; clankie auto / /auto is the switch, get_wake reads the pending wake.
That record moved to a new number; docs/adr/README.md#renumbered-records maps each former file to it.

claims.pattern: It sleeps when idle and the app or a Discord mention wakes
claims.now: Managed presence has no automatic idle sleep or active-hour cap; confirm rollout on older deployments.

Leads retire a seat past about 300K tokens of context (lead skill). Accepted ADR 0293 sets the default lead's 250K / 12h restart and 300K Claude backstop; hired-seat automation remains tracked in VUH-2820.
His mailbox is the owner's own IMAP/SMTP server, connected with /connect email; the hosted Clankie mailbox is gone.

claims.pattern: free official Clankie bot|official Clankie bot \(free
claims.now: Discord runs on the owner's own bot or lab user session; the shared official bot setting is gone.
A pull request rebases onto origin/main once, right before it merges, and pushes with --force-with-lease to its own branch; it never merges main in repeatedly.

The integrate queue is gone. Every change lands through a pull request that merges on local checks plus the quick PR checks, rebased once right before merging. Deploy holds are `clankie update holds|hold|release`.
Clankie's own pull requests merge once their checks are green; a project reviewer's verdict is read with `clankie review status`.

claims.pattern: land(s)? (clankie and clankie-app )?changes directly on `?main|changes land directly on `?main\b
claims.now: Every change lands through a pull request that merges on local checks plus the quick PR checks, rebased once right before merging.
Remote gates went with the integrate queue.
